name: sdlc-extras
description: Optional companions to the sdlc plugin: the Ralph loop (/sdlc-extras:ralph-loop), hookify's list, configure and help commands, and the conversation-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, comment-analyzer and code-simplifier agents that /sdlc:hookify and /sdlc:review-pr use when present, and the feature-reviewer agent for a review on request.
